meta.name: The Circle
meta.description: This social experiment brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone. Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game. This fresh take supercharges the original's signature mix of strategy and deception into an addictive experience built for today's always-on audience.

videos.title: Welcome to the Circle
videos.overview: The ultimate game of social strategy begins, as 8 players move into separate apartments and communicate only through The Circle platform, all competing for a $100,000 grand prize. With celebrities and everyday players competing side by side, and some hiding behind catfish identities, anything is possible. Hosted by social media star Tinx, the competition kicks off with a revealing game that puts the players’ personalities on full display before they rate each other in hopes of earning the coveted title of Influencer and the power to shape the game.

videos.title: Y2 Chaotic
videos.overview: The competition heats up as the Influencers face a big decision that will have a major impact on another player's game. Then, a familiar face enters The Circle, but there's more to this new player than meets the eye. When the players let loose at a Y2K-themed party, a surprise announcement reveals they're not the only ones with a say in the game.

videos.title: Circle Crimes
videos.overview: It's a courtroom showdown as accusations fly and the players put each other's Circle crimes on trial. After delivering their verdicts, they cast their second ratings to determine the next Influencers. The newly crowned Influencers hand down a blocking sentence, but the player on the receiving end is shocked to learn they may have a chance at a reprieve.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: America has spoken, and its vote sends shockwaves through The Circle, unleashing a game-changing twist! One Player gets a second chance at the game by stealing another Player's identity, leaving two competing profiles. As the Players scramble to figure out who's the real deal, a special guest joins the fun for a game of truth and deception. With suspicions running high, the Players must decide which identity deserves to stay. But can they spot the imposter before it's too late?

videos.title: Identity Showdown
videos.overview: The Circle's identity theft investigation reaches its climax as the players must vote on which of the two identical profiles is the real deal and which is the impostor. Their decision sends one player packing, but the competition...

videos.title: Thanks for Nothing
videos.overview: A celebrity crashes Thanksgiving, and one player claims unprecedented power!
